overview:
**Fire danger is Very High today in the Montrose High Elevation area, driven by parched fuels (ERC 97%, BI 99%) and single-digit humidity.**
- Danger climbs to Extreme from Friday through Monday, easing back to Very High by next Wednesday as afternoon humidity stays in the teens or lower most of that stretch.
- A Red Flag Warning is in effect until 8 PM tonight for gusty winds and low humidity; patchy smoke is expected after 3 PM.
- Watchout conditions are active — 4 of 7 local thresholds are exceeded, including ERC, BI, minimum RH (7%), and max RH (32%).
- Gunnison County is currently in Stage 2 Fire Restrictions, with no open burning or campfires allowed. BLM lands in Montrose, Delta, Mesa, Gunnison, Ouray and San Miguel counties remain under Stage 1 restrictions.
- The Gold Mountain Fire near Ouray stands at 39,507 acres and 89% contained; the Elk Fire near Lake City has grown to 2,785 acres and is 44% contained.
